mapper.select: SELECT financial_goal_template_id, goal_name, description, icon_key, sort_order FROM financial_goal_template WHERE is_default = 1 AND is_active = 1 AND created_by_member_id IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, financial_goal_template_id ASC

SELECT financial_goal_template_id, goal_name, description, icon_key, sort_order FROM financial_goal_template WHERE financial_goal_template_id = #{financialGoalTemplateId} AND is_default = 1 AND is_active = 1 AND created_by_member_id IS NULL

SELECT financial_goal_recommendation_basis_id, financial_goal_template_id, recommendation_method, organization, dataset_name, reference_year, metric_name, metric_value, metric_unit, source_url, description, disclaimer FROM financial_goal_recommendation_basis WHERE financial_goal_template_id = #{financialGoalTemplateId}

SELECT financial_goal_amount_recommendation_id, financial_goal_template_id, recommendation_code, title, target_amount, coverage_items, display_order FROM financial_goal_amount_recommendation WHERE financial_goal_template_id = #{financialGoalTemplateId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY display_order ASC, financial_goal_amount_recommendation_id ASC
